"""Shared name->product matcher, implemented from parsers/_matching-engine.md."""
import re
import statistics

MODEL_MODIFIERS = {"pro", "ultra", "lite", "plus", "max", "mini", "note", "redmi",
                   # genuine model designators, not marketing words. Without "air",
                   # an "iPhone Air" target carries NO model token at all.
                   "air", "fe", "se"}

NON_MODEL_TOKENS = {"gb", "гб", "tb", "тб", "smartfon", "смартфон", "iphone",
                    "apple", "samsung", "honor", "xiaomi", "vivo", "oppo",
                    "realme", "tecno", "infinix", "poco", "nothing", "google",
                    "asus", "huawei", "motorola", "zte", "meizu",
                    "esim", "nanosim", "sim", "nano", "point",
                    # uz filler words: "Kumush rang" = silver COLOUR, "rang" is not one
                    "rang", "smartfoni", "telefon", "chidamli", "zarbaga"}

COLOR_MAP = {
    # english base words only -- never finish/qualifier words
    "black": "black", "midnight": "black", "obsidian": "black", "graphite": "black",
    "white": "white", "moonlight": "white", "cloud": "white",
    "silver": "silver", "meteor": "silver", "titanium": "silver",
    "gray": "gray", "grey": "gray", "space": "gray", "charcoal": "gray",
    "gold": "gold", "desert": "gold", "sunrise": "gold", "champagne": "gold",
    "blue": "blue", "cyan": "blue", "ocean": "blue", "aqua": "blue",
    "navy": "blue", "sky": "blue", "glacier": "blue", "denim": "blue",
    "red": "red", "scarlet": "red",
    "brown": "brown", "reddish": "brown", "coffee": "brown", "titan": "brown",
    "green": "green", "sage": "green", "mint": "green", "emerald": "green",
    "jade": "green", "forest": "green", "marrs": "green", "agate": "green",
    "purple": "purple", "violet": "purple", "cobalt": "purple",
    "lavender": "purple", "lilac": "purple", "plum": "purple",
    "orange": "orange", "cosmic": "orange", "amber": "orange", "coral": "orange",
    "pink": "pink", "rose": "pink", "sandy": "gold", "sand": "gold",
    "beige": "beige", "cream": "beige", "ivory": "beige",
    "burgundy": "burgundy", "wine": "burgundy",
    "yellow": "yellow", "lime": "yellow",
    # russian set (uzum.md section 8) -- token level, after e-diaeresis folding
    "черный": "black", "черное": "black", "черная": "black", "чёрный": "black",
    "угольный": "gray", "серый": "gray", "серебряный": "silver",
    "серебристый": "silver", "титановый": "silver",
    "синий": "blue", "голубой": "blue", "ледяной": "blue", "бирюзовый": "blue",
    "фиолетовый": "purple", "лавандовый": "purple", "сиреневый": "purple",
    "зеленый": "green", "мятный": "green",
    "оранжевый": "orange", "манго": "orange",
    "золотой": "gold", "золотистый": "gold", "песочный": "gold",
    "бежевый": "beige", "кремовый": "beige",
    "белый": "white", "молочный": "white",
    "бордовый": "burgundy", "коричневый": "brown", "алый": "red",
    "красный": "red", "розовый": "pink", "желтый": "yellow",
    # latin transliterations seen in uz-locale listings
    "cherniy": "black", "chernyi": "black",
    "beliy": "white", "seriy": "gray", "siniy": "blue", "goluboy": "blue",
    "zeleniy": "green", "fioletoviy": "purple", "rozoviy": "pink",
    "zolotoy": "gold", "serebristiy": "silver",
    # UZBEK -- uzum serves uz-language listings; uzum.md's "colours are Russian
    # only" holds for the Цвет characteristic but NOT for card/model strings.
    "qora": "black", "oq": "white", "kumush": "silver", "kulrang": "gray",
    "tilla": "gold", "oltin": "gold", "sariq": "yellow",
    "yashil": "green", "kok": "blue", "ko'k": "blue", "moviy": "blue",
    "muz": "blue", "binafsha": "purple", "pushti": "pink",
    "qizil": "red", "jigarrang": "brown", "bej": "beige",
}

# qualifier words that must NEVER be mapped (they would act as wildcards)
QUALIFIERS = {"velvet", "light", "dark", "golden", "deep", "тёмно", "темно",
              "светло", "небесно", "металлик", "меланж", "matte", "glossy"}

ACCEPT_THRESHOLD = 30


def normalize(s):
    if not s:
        return ""
    t = str(s).lower().strip()
    for a, b in [("–", "-"), ("—", "-"), (",", " "), ("/", " "), ("|", " "), ("ё", "е")]:
        t = t.replace(a, b)
    # '+' -> ' plus ' ONLY as a trailing model marker (e.g. "Pro+"). A '+' inside
    # "SIM+eSIM" is followed by a letter, so it becomes a plain space instead.
    t = re.sub(r"\+(?=\s|$)", " plus ", t)
    t = t.replace("+", " ")
    t = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", t, flags=re.UNICODE)
    t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t).strip()
    return t


def extract_features(name):
    n = normalize(name)
    n = re.sub(r"\bсмартфон\b", "", n).strip()
    n = re.sub(r"\bsmartfon\w*\b", "", n).strip()

    brand = None
    for b in ["iphone", "apple", "samsung", "honor", "xiaomi", "redmi", "vivo",
              "oppo", "realme", "tecno", "infinix", "poco", "nothing", "google",
              "asus", "huawei", "motorola", "zte", "meizu"]:
        if b in n:
            brand = {"iphone": "apple", "redmi": "xiaomi", "poco": "xiaomi"}.get(b, b)
            break

    storage = ram = None

    # Collect ALL unit-bearing figures -- sellers write "8ГБ/256ГБ" and "12GB+512GB",
    # where a single-match regex reads the RAM as the storage.
    units = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?<![a-zа-я\d])(\d{1,4})\s*(gb|гб|tb|тб)\b", n):
        val = int(m.group(1))
        if m.group(2) in ("tb", "тб"):
            val *= 1024
        units.append(val)

    if len(units) >= 2:
        storage = max(units)
        if min(units) <= 24:
            ram = min(units)
    elif len(units) == 1:
        if units[0] >= 32:
            storage = units[0]
        else:
            ram = units[0]

    if storage is None:                       # bare "6 128" form
        for m in re.finditer(r"(?<![a-zа-я\d])(\d{1,3})\s+(\d{2,4})(?!\d)", n):
            a, b = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
            if max(a, b) >= 32:
                storage = max(a, b)
                break

    # A bare "12 256" pair usually means RAM/storage -- but "iPhone 16 256 GB" has
    # the identical shape, and reading 16 as RAM moves it into reserved_nums, which
    # DELETES the model number from model_tokens and lets iPhone 16 / 17 / Air all
    # match each other. normalize() has already erased the "/" that would tell them
    # apart, so test the raw string, and never infer RAM for Apple (which does not
    # publish RAM in consumer names).
    has_pair_sep = bool(re.search(r"\d\s*[/\\+|]\s*\d", str(name or "")))
    if ram is None and (has_pair_sep or brand != "apple"):
        for m in re.finditer(r"(?<![a-zа-я\d])(\d{1,2})\s+(\d{2,4})(?!\d)", n):
            a, b = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
            if min(a, b) <= 24 and max(a, b) >= 32:
                ram = min(a, b)
                break

    tokens = set(n.split())
    colors = {COLOR_MAP[t] for t in tokens if t in COLOR_MAP}
    # did the string state a colour we could NOT resolve?
    color_raw = any(t not in COLOR_MAP and t in QUALIFIERS for t in tokens)

    reserved_nums = {str(storage or ""), str(ram or ""), "5g", "4g", "0"}
    model_tokens = set()
    for t in tokens:
        if t in NON_MODEL_TOKENS or t in COLOR_MAP or t in QUALIFIERS or t in reserved_nums:
            continue
        if re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:gb|гб|tb|тб)", t):
            continue
        # Skip SKU/catalogue codes (letters+digits, len >= 5): "a075f", "sm-a175f".
        # Real model designators (a07, a17, x9d, y31d) are <= 4 chars.
        if len(t) >= 5 and any(c.isalpha() for c in t) and any(c.isdigit() for c in t):
            continue
        if any(c.isdigit() for c in t):
            if t.isdigit() and int(t) in {(storage or -1), (ram or -1)}:
                continue
            model_tokens.add(t)
        elif t in MODEL_MODIFIERS:
            model_tokens.add(t)

    return {"brand": brand, "ram": ram, "storage": storage, "colors": colors,
            "n": n, "model_tokens": model_tokens, "color_raw": color_raw}


def score_match(t, c):
    score = 0
    if t["brand"] and c["brand"]:
        if t["brand"] != c["brand"]:
            return -100
        score += 10
    if t["storage"] and c["storage"]:
        if t["storage"] == c["storage"]:
            score += 20
        else:
            return -100
    elif t["storage"] and not c["storage"]:
        return -100                      # kills accessories for free
    if t["ram"] and c["ram"]:
        if t["ram"] == c["ram"]:
            score += 10
        else:
            return -100

    cand_tokens = set(c["n"].split())
    for mt in t["model_tokens"]:
        if mt not in cand_tokens and mt not in c["n"]:
            return -100
    for mt in c["model_tokens"]:         # reverse direction: stops Pro Max matching Pro
        if mt not in t["n"].split() and mt not in t["n"]:
            return -100
    if t["model_tokens"] or c["model_tokens"]:
        score += 15

    if t["colors"] and c["colors"]:
        if not (t["colors"] & c["colors"]):
            return -100
        score += 5
    elif t["colors"] and not c["colors"]:
        # candidate stated no resolvable colour -> cannot confirm the variant
        return -100
    return score


def why(t, c):
    if t["brand"] and c["brand"] and t["brand"] != c["brand"]:
        return "brand %s!=%s" % (c["brand"], t["brand"])
    if t["storage"] and c["storage"] and t["storage"] != c["storage"]:
        return "storage %s!=%s" % (c["storage"], t["storage"])
    if t["storage"] and not c["storage"]:
        return "cand has NO storage"
    if t["ram"] and c["ram"] and t["ram"] != c["ram"]:
        return "ram %s!=%s" % (c["ram"], t["ram"])
    ct = set(c["n"].split())
    for mt in t["model_tokens"]:
        if mt not in ct and mt not in c["n"]:
            return "target token '%s' missing" % mt
    for mt in c["model_tokens"]:
        if mt not in t["n"].split() and mt not in t["n"]:
            return "cand token '%s' extra" % mt
    if t["colors"] and not c["colors"]:
        return "cand colour unresolvable"
    if t["colors"] and c["colors"] and not (t["colors"] & c["colors"]):
        return "colour %s vs %s" % (c["colors"], t["colors"])
    return "OK"


def robust_median(prices):
    """Median after IQR outlier stripping (only strips when >= 4 samples)."""
    prices = sorted(prices)
    if not prices:
        return None, []
    if len(prices) < 4:
        return statistics.median(prices), prices
    q1, _, q3 = statistics.quantiles(prices, n=4, method="inclusive")
    iqr = q3 - q1
    lo, hi = q1 - 1.5 * iqr, q3 + 1.5 * iqr
    kept = [p for p in prices if lo <= p <= hi] or prices
    return statistics.median(kept), kept


_DUAL = re.compile(r"(nano)?sim\+e-?sim|dualsim|2sim|двесим")
_ESIM = re.compile(r"e-?sim")


def is_esim_only(text):
    low = re.sub(r"[\s_.\-]", "", str(text).lower())
    if _DUAL.search(low):
        return False
    return bool(_ESIM.search(low))

import json, os, sys, statistics

S = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
R = json.load(open(os.path.join(S, "results.json"), encoding="utf-8"))


def f(v):
    return "{:,}".format(v) if v else "-"


print("=" * 132)
print("HEAD-TO-HEAD: uzprice headline price vs variant-exact price (20 of their most comparison-rich smartphone pages)")
print("=" * 132)
print("{:<44} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11}".format(
    "page (the exact variant it claims to be)", "uzprice", "their own", "ours", "ours+uzum", "uzum med"))
print("{:<44} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11}".format(
    "", "headline", "re-filtered", "5 stores", "+beeline", "(spread)"))
print("-" * 132)
for r in R:
    print("{:<44} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11} {:>11}".format(
        r["name"][:44], f(r["uzprice_headline"]), f(r["uzprice_colour_exact"]),
        f(r["ours_shared_min"]), f(r["ours_all_min"]),
        f(int(r["uzum_median"]) if r["uzum_median"] else None)))

# --- 1. how wrong is their headline, measured on the SAME 5 stores they index
print("\n" + "=" * 132)
print("1. HEADLINE ERROR  (their number vs the colour-exact truth on the same stores)")
print("-" * 132)
errs = []
for r in R:
    if r["ours_shared_min"]:
        d = r["ours_shared_min"] - r["uzprice_headline"]
        errs.append((d, d / r["uzprice_headline"] * 100, r))
errs.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
wrong = [e for e in errs if e[0] != 0]
print("pages where the headline understates the real colour-exact price: {}/{}".format(len(wrong), len(errs)))
if wrong:
    print("median error among those: {:+,} sum ({:+.1f}%)   max: {:+,} sum ({:+.1f}%)".format(
        int(statistics.median([w[0] for w in wrong])), statistics.median([w[1] for w in wrong]),
        wrong[0][0], wrong[0][1]))
for d, pct, r in wrong:
    print("  {:+11,} ({:+5.1f}%)  {:<42} advertised {:>11} but that price is a {} listing".format(
        d, pct, r["name"][:42], f(r["uzprice_headline"]),
        (r["uzprice_headline_from"] or "").split(",")[-1].strip()[:22]))

# --- 2. does our independent fetch corroborate their own re-filtered data
print("\n" + "=" * 132)
print("2. CROSS-CHECK  (our independent fetch vs their own offer table, re-filtered to the right colour)")
print("-" * 132)
agree = near = diff = 0
for r in R:
    a, b = r["ours_shared_min"], r["uzprice_colour_exact"]
    if not a or not b:
        continue
    if a == b:
        agree += 1
    elif abs(a - b) / b <= 0.02:
        near += 1
    else:
        diff += 1
        print("  differ >2%: {:<42} ours {:>11}  theirs {:>11}".format(r["name"][:42], f(a), f(b)))
print("exact agreement: {}   within 2%: {}   differ >2%: {}".format(agree, near, diff))

# --- 3. what uzum + beemarket add
print("\n" + "=" * 132)
print("3. WHAT UZUM + BEEMARKET ADD  (sources uzprice does not index at all)")
print("-" * 132)
better = 0
for r in R:
    if r["ours_all_min"] and r["ours_shared_min"] and r["ours_all_min"] < r["ours_shared_min"]:
        better += 1
        d = r["ours_shared_min"] - r["ours_all_min"]
        print("  {:<42} {:>11} -> {:>11}  saves {:>9,} ({:.1f}%) via {}".format(
            r["name"][:42], f(r["ours_shared_min"]), f(r["ours_all_min"]), d,
            d / r["ours_shared_min"] * 100, r["ours_all_store"]))
print("cheaper-than-anything-uzprice-indexes on {}/{} pages".format(better, len(R)))
uz = [r for r in R if r["uzum_min"]]
print("\nuzum matched {}/{} targets; beemarket {}/{}".format(
    len(uz), len(R), len([r for r in R if r["beemarket_min"]]), len(R)))
spread = [(r["uzum_median"] / r["uzum_min"], r) for r in uz if r["uzum_min"] and r["uzum_median"]]
spread.sort(key=lambda x: -x[0])
print("\ngrey-market spread on uzum (median/min) -- invisible to any single-card aggregator:")
for ratio, r in spread[:8]:
    print("  x{:.2f}  {:<42} min {:>11}  median {:>11}".format(
        ratio, r["name"][:42], f(r["uzum_min"]), f(int(r["uzum_median"]))))

# --- 4. coverage
print("\n" + "=" * 132)
print("4. COVERAGE  (variant-exact matches per source across the 20 targets)")
print("-" * 132)
for s in ["alifshop", "uzum", "olcha", "beemarket", "idea", "texnomart", "mediapark"]:
    n = sum(1 for r in R if s in r["per_store"])
    print("  {:<11} {:2}/20".format(s, n))

"""Retailer clients, re-implemented from the parsers/*.md notes.

Each returns a list of candidates: {"name": str, "price": int SUM, "url": str, "store": str}
"name" is the string the matcher scores against.
"""
import base64, json, re, time, urllib.parse, uuid

import requests

from matcher import COLOR_MAP, is_esim_only, normalize

UA = ("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
      "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/150.0.0.0 Safari/537.36")

TIMEOUT = (15, 60)
DELAY = 0.4


def _num(v):
    try:
        return int(float(v))
    except Exception:
        return None


def strip_prefix(name):
    return re.sub(r"^\s*Смартфон\s+", "", name).strip()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- alifshop
def _alifshop_once(session, q, pages, out, seen):
    for page in range(pages):
        r = session.post("https://gw.alifshop.uz/web/client/search/full-text",
                         headers={"Accept": "application/json", "Accept-Language": "ru",
                                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                                  "service-token": "service-token-alifshop",
                                  "Origin": "https://alifshop.uz",
                                  "Referer": "https://alifshop.uz/", "User-Agent": UA},
                         json={"query": q, "page": page, "size": 20}, timeout=TIMEOUT)
        d = r.json() or {}
        for it in d.get("items") or []:
            p = _num(it.get("price"))
            nm = ((it.get("product") or {}).get("name")) or ""
            if not p or not nm or it.get("slug") in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(it.get("slug"))
            out.append({"name": nm, "price": p // 100,          # TIYIN -> SUM
                        "url": "https://alifshop.uz/moderated-offer/%s" % it.get("slug"),
                        "store": "alifshop"})
        if page + 1 >= (d.get("n_pages") or 1):
            break
        time.sleep(DELAY)
    return out


def alifshop(session, name, pages=3):
    """Two-shot: colour-stripped first, then verbatim, deduped by slug.

    alifshop.md says broad stripping "isn't needed" here -- measured false. A target
    named "Glacier Blue" misses the listing alifshop calls "Синий" entirely, so the
    colour must come out of the QUERY and be enforced in the matcher instead.
    """
    verbatim = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"\bGB\b", "", strip_prefix(name), flags=re.I)).strip()
    broad = " ".join(t for t in verbatim.split()
                     if t.lower().strip(",()") not in set(COLOR_MAP))
    broad = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", broad).strip()
    out, seen = [], set()
    for q in ([broad, verbatim] if broad and broad != verbatim else [verbatim]):
        _alifshop_once(session, q, pages, out, seen)
        time.sleep(DELAY)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- beemarket
_DROP = set(COLOR_MAP) | {"awesome", "5g", "4g", "xiaomi", "point", "sim", "esim",
                          "nanosim", "nano", "gb", "гб", "tb", "тб"}


def _broad_query(name):
    n = strip_prefix(name)
    n = re.sub(r"\b(\d{1,2})[/ ](\d{2,4})\b", r"\2", n)      # "12/256" -> "256"
    toks = [t for t in n.split() if t.lower().strip(",()") not in _DROP]
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", " ".join(toks)).strip()


def beemarket(session, name, pages=3):
    q = _broad_query(name)
    out = []
    for page in range(1, pages + 1):
        r = session.get("https://market.beeline.uz/api/web/search",
                        params={"q": q, "is_bshop": 1, "page": page},
                        headers={"Accept": "*/*", "Accept-Language": "ru",
                                 "Referer": "https://market.beeline.uz/", "User-Agent": UA},
                        timeout=TIMEOUT)
        d = ((r.json() or {}).get("data")) or {}
        for it in d.get("data") or []:
            p = _num(it.get("actual_price")) or _num(it.get("discount_price")) or _num(it.get("price"))
            if not p or not it.get("name"):
                continue
            cat = ((it.get("category") or {}).get("slug")) or "smartfony"
            out.append({"name": it["name"], "price": p,
                        "url": "https://market.beeline.uz/%s/%s" % (cat, it.get("slug")),
                        "store": "beemarket"})
        if page >= (d.get("last_page") or 1):
            break
        time.sleep(DELAY)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- texnomart
def texnomart(session, name, pages=3):
    q = _broad_query(name)
    out = []
    for page in range(1, pages + 1):
        r = session.get("https://gw.texnomart.uz/api/common/v1/search/result",
                        params={"q": q, "page": page, "limit": 20},
                        headers={"Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
                                 "accept-device": "web", "accept-language": "uz",
                                 "accept-region": "2", "Origin": "https://texnomart.uz",
                                 "Referer": "https://texnomart.uz/", "User-Agent": UA},
                        timeout=TIMEOUT)
        d = ((r.json() or {}).get("data")) or {}
        for it in d.get("products") or []:
            p = _num(it.get("sale_price"))           # old_price is often 0 -- never fall back
            if not p or not it.get("name"):
                continue
            out.append({"name": it["name"], "price": p,
                        "url": "https://texnomart.uz/product/detail/%s/" % it.get("id"),
                        "store": "texnomart"})
        if page >= ((d.get("pagination") or {}).get("total_page") or 1):
            break
        time.sleep(DELAY)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- idea
def idea(session, name, **_):
    r = session.get("https://api.idea.uz/api/v2/search",
                    params={"search": strip_prefix(name), "quantity": 20,
                            "type[]": ["shops", "products"]},
                    headers={"Accept": "application/json", "Accept-Language": "uz",
                             "Origin": "https://idea.uz", "Referer": "https://idea.uz/",
                             "User-Agent": UA}, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    out = []
    for it in (r.json() or {}).get("products") or []:
        p = _num(it.get("current_price"))
        if not p or not it.get("name"):
            continue
        out.append({"name": it["name"], "price": p,
                    "url": it.get("url"), "store": "idea"})       # absolute URL, verbatim
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mediapark
def mediapark(session, name, **_):
    q = re.sub(r"\bGB\b", "", strip_prefix(name), flags=re.I)     # keep it SPECIFIC
    q = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", q).strip()
    r = session.get("https://api.v2.mediapark.uz/v1/diginetica/autocomplete",
                    params={"st": q, "lang": "ru"},
                    headers={"Accept": "*/*", "Content-Type": "application/json",
                             "Accept-Language": "ru", "Origin": "https://mediapark.uz",
                             "Referer": "https://mediapark.uz/",
                             "x-device-id": "Ywh1FNq17HzyCBJ15BDZl",
                             "x-session-id": "vzNu2usamNvHs6plQvNO4",
                             "User-Agent": UA}, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    out = []
    for it in (r.json() or {}).get("products") or []:
        p = _num(it.get("price"))                                  # STRING in the JSON
        if not p or not it.get("name"):
            continue
        out.append({"name": it["name"], "price": p,                # slug lies -- use linkUrl verbatim
                    "url": "https://mediapark.uz" + str(it.get("linkUrl") or ""),
                    "store": "mediapark"})
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- olcha (catalogue)
_OLCHA_CACHE = []


def olcha_catalog(session):
    global _OLCHA_CACHE
    if _OLCHA_CACHE:
        return _OLCHA_CACHE
    items, page, last = [], 1, 1
    while page <= last:
        r = session.get("https://mobile.olcha.uz/api/v2/products",
                        params={"page": page, "per_page": 20, "category": "telefony"},
                        headers={"Accept": "*/*", "Accept-Language": "ru",
                                 "clientmodel": "web", "Origin": "https://olcha.uz",
                                 "Referer": "https://olcha.uz/", "User-Agent": UA},
                        timeout=(15, 90))
        d = ((r.json() or {}).get("data")) or {}
        for p in d.get("products") or []:
            price = _num(p.get("discount_price")) or _num(p.get("total_price"))
            if not (price and p.get("name_ru") and p.get("alias")):
                continue
            items.append({"name": p["name_ru"], "price": price,
                          "url": "https://olcha.uz/ru/product/view/%s" % p["alias"],
                          "store": "olcha"})
        last = (d.get("paginator") or {}).get("last_page", 1)
        page += 1
        time.sleep(0.3)
    _OLCHA_CACHE = items
    return items


def olcha(session, name, **_):
    return olcha_catalog(session)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- uzum
_UZ = {"token": None, "iid": None, "exp": 0}

_SEARCH_QUERY = """
query getMakeSearch($q: MakeSearchQueryInput!) {
  makeSearch(query: $q) {
    total
    items {
      catalogCard {
        __typename
        productId
        title
        category { id title }
        ... on SkuGroupCard {
          skuList {
            id sellPrice fullPrice availableAmount
            characteristicValues { title characteristic { title } }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
"""

PHONE_CATEGORIES = {15271, 15272}


def _uzum_token(session):
    if _UZ["token"] and time.time() < _UZ["exp"] - 300:
        return _UZ["token"], _UZ["iid"]
    iid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    s = requests.Session()
    s.post("https://id.uzum.uz/api/auth/token",
           headers={"Accept": "*/*", "Accept-Language": "ru-RU",      # required
                    "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    "Origin": "https://uzum.uz",
                    "Referer": "https://uzum.uz/",                    # required
                    "User-Agent": UA, "x-iid": iid},
           json={}, timeout=25)
    token = next(c.value for c in s.cookies if c.name == "access_token")
    p = token.split(".")[1]
    p += "=" * (-len(p) % 4)
    _UZ.update(token=token, iid=iid, exp=json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p))["exp"])
    return token, iid


def _char_kind(key):
    k = normalize(key)
    if k.startswith("памя") or k.startswith("xotira") or "объем памяти" in k:
        return "memory"
    if k.startswith("модел") or k.startswith("model"):
        return "model"
    if "sim" in k or "сим" in k:
        return "sim"
    if k.startswith("цвет") or k.startswith("rang"):
        return "color"
    return "other"


def _uzum_query(name):
    """Broad: drop colour words and 5G/4G -- uzum's search is strict AND."""
    n = strip_prefix(name)
    n = re.sub(r"\bГБ\b|\bGB\b", "", n, flags=re.I)
    toks = [t for t in n.split() if t.lower().strip(",()") not in (set(COLOR_MAP) | {"5g", "4g"})]
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", " ".join(toks)).strip()


def uzum(session, name, **_):
    token, iid = _uzum_token(session)
    out, seen = [], set()
    for q in [_uzum_query(name), strip_prefix(name)]:
        r = session.post("https://graphql.uzum.uz/",
                         headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token,
                                  "Content-Type": "application/json",
                                  "apollographql-client-name": "web-customers",   # required
                                  "apollographql-client-version": "1.63.2",
                                  "x-iid": iid,                                   # required
                                  "city-id": "1", "Origin": "https://uzum.uz",
                                  "Referer": "https://uzum.uz/", "User-Agent": UA},
                         json={"query": _SEARCH_QUERY,
                               "variables": {"q": {"text": q, "showAdultContent": "TRUE",
                                                   "filters": [], "sort": "BY_RELEVANCE_DESC",
                                                   "pagination": {"offset": 0, "limit": 72}}}},
                         timeout=(15, 90))
        d = r.json() or {}
        if d.get("errors"):                       # HTTP 200 + errors key is the failure mode
            raise RuntimeError("uzum graphql: %s" % json.dumps(d["errors"])[:200])
        for item in (((d.get("data") or {}).get("makeSearch") or {}).get("items") or []):
            card = item.get("catalogCard") or {}
            if ((card.get("category") or {}).get("id")) not in PHONE_CATEGORIES:
                continue
            title = card.get("title") or ""
            head = title.split(",")[0]                      # blurb after first comma
            for sku in card.get("skuList") or []:
                if (sku.get("availableAmount") or 0) <= 0:  # phantom listings
                    continue
                if sku["id"] in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(sku["id"])
                model_v = mem_v = color_v = sim_v = ""
                for cv in sku.get("characteristicValues") or []:
                    kind = _char_kind((cv.get("characteristic") or {}).get("title") or "")
                    val = cv.get("title") or ""
                    if kind == "model":
                        model_v = val
                    elif kind == "memory":
                        mem_v = val
                    elif kind == "color":
                        color_v = val
                    elif kind == "sim":
                        sim_v = val
                spec = model_v or head
                if mem_v:      # sku states its own memory -> strip the card's range
                    spec = re.sub(r"(?<![a-zа-я])\d{1,4}\s*(?:gb|гб|tb|тб)?\s*[/\\+|]\s*"
                                  r"\d{1,4}\s*(?:gb|гб|tb|тб)?", " ", spec, flags=re.I)
                    spec = re.sub(r"(?<![a-zа-я\d])\d{1,4}\s*(?:gb|гб|tb|тб)\b", " ", spec, flags=re.I)
                cand = " ".join(x for x in [head.split()[0] if head else "", spec, mem_v, color_v] if x)
                if is_esim_only(" ".join([model_v, sim_v, title])):
                    continue
                out.append({"name": cand, "price": int(sku["sellPrice"]),
                            "url": "https://uzum.uz/ru/product/%s?skuId=%s" % (card.get("productId"), sku["id"]),
                            "store": "uzum"})
        time.sleep(DELAY)
    return out


CLIENTS = {"uzum": uzum, "alifshop": alifshop, "beemarket": beemarket,
           "idea": idea, "olcha": olcha, "texnomart": texnomart, "mediapark": mediapark}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

// Ensure a lang cookie exists so the first render (and every request) has a
// locale. No URL prefix: the site is served at stable paths; language is a
// cookie preference (sitemap/hreflang stay simple).
export function middleware(req: NextRequest) {
  const hasLang = req.cookies.has("lang");
  const res = NextResponse.next();
  if (!hasLang) {
    res.cookies.set("lang", "ru", { path: "/", maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365 });
  }
  return res;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ["/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|api|sitemap.xml|robots.txt).*)"],
};

FILE: narxnoma-web/app/page.tsx

import Link from "next/link";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import CategoryGrid from "@/components/CategoryGrid";
import SearchBox from "@/components/SearchBox";
import VariantCard from "@/components/VariantCard";
import { langFromCookie, plural, price, t, timeAgo } from "@/lib/i18n";
import {
  getBrandsByCategory,
  getFeaturedPerCategory,
  getHomeStats,
} from "@/lib/queries";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const NON_PHONE = new Set(["televisions", "laptops", "acs", "fridges", "washers", "ovens"]);

export default async function HomePage() {
  const lang = langFromCookie((await cookies()).get("lang")?.value);
  const [stats, perCategory, brandRows] = await Promise.all([
    getHomeStats(),
    getFeaturedPerCategory(8),
    getBrandsByCategory(),
  ]);

  // Aggregate per-category brand rows into the category grid's numbers.
  const catMap = new Map<string, { count: number; stores: number; min_price: number | null }>();
  for (const b of brandRows) {
    const cur = catMap.get(b.category) ?? { count: 0, stores: 0, min_price: null };
    cur.count += Number(b.count);
    cur.stores = Math.max(cur.stores, Number(b.stores));
    const p0 = b.min_price != null ? Number(b.min_price) : null;
    cur.min_price = cur.min_price == null || (p0 != null && p0 < cur.min_price) ? p0 : cur.min_price;
    catMap.set(b.category, cur);
  }
  const categoryRows = [...catMap.entries()].map(([category, v]) => ({
    category, count: v.count, stores: v.stores, min_price: v.min_price,
  }));

  const catLabel = (c: string) => {
    const v = t(lang, `cat.${c}`);
    return v && !v.startsWith("cat.") ? v : c;
  };

  return (
    <main>
      <section className="hero">
        <h1>{t(lang, "hero.title", { n: stats.stores })}</h1>
        <p className="sub">{t(lang, "hero.sub")}</p>
        <SearchBox big />
        <div className="stat-strip">
          <div className="stat">
            <span className="num">{stats.variants_priced}</span>
            <span className="lbl">
              {plural(lang, stats.variants_priced, "model", "модель", "модели", "моделей")}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="stat">
            <span className="num">{stats.stores}</span>
            <span className="lbl">
              {plural(lang, stats.stores, t(lang, "stat.stores"), "магазин", "магазина", "магазинов")}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="stat">
            <span className="num">{stats.last_updated ? timeAgo(lang, stats.last_updated) : "—"}</span>
            <span className="lbl">{lang === "uz" ? "narx tekshiruvi" : "проверка цен"}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="sec">
        <div className="page">
          <div className="result-head">
            <h2>{t(lang, "home.categories")}</h2>
            <Link href="/catalog" className="more-link">{t(lang, "home.more")} →</Link>
          </div>
          <CategoryGrid rows={categoryRows} columns={4} />
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="sec">
        <div className="page">
          <div className="result-head">
            <h2>{t(lang, "home.popular")}</h2>
          </div>
          {perCategory.map(({ category, hits }) => {
            const seeAll = {
              ru: "Смотреть все →",
              uz: "Barchasini ko'rish →",
            }[lang];
            return (
              <div key={category} style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                <div className="row-head">
                  <h3 style={{ fontSize: 15, fontWeight: 600 }}>{catLabel(category)}</h3>
                </div>
                {NON_PHONE.has(category) ? (
                  <>
                    {/* Horizontal scroll so the user can surf the category on the
                        page, with the "see all" button under the scroller. */}
                    <div className="hscroll">
                      {hits.map((v) => <VariantCard key={v.id} v={v} />)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="hscroll-more">
                      <Link href={`/catalog?category=${category}`} className="btn">
                        {seeAll}
                      </Link>
                    </div>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <div className="grid">
                      {hits.map((v) => <VariantCard key={v.id} v={v} />)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="hscroll-more">
                      <Link href={`/catalog?category=${category}`} className="btn">
                        {seeAll}
                      </Link>
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

import type { MetadataRoute } from "next";
import { getBrandsByCategory } from "@/lib/queries";

export const revalidate = 3600;

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const base = "https://narxnoma.uz";
  const brands = await getBrandsByCategory();
  const urls: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = [
    { url: base, changeFrequency: "daily", priority: 1 },
    { url: `${base}/search`, changeFrequency: "daily", priority: 0.9 },
    { url: `${base}/stores`, changeFrequency: "daily", priority: 0.4 },
    { url: `${base}/about`, changeFrequency: "monthly", priority: 0.3 },
    { url: `${base}/c/smartphones`, changeFrequency: "daily", priority: 0.8 },
  ];
  for (const b of brands) {
    urls.push({
      url: `${base}/c/${b.category}/${b.brand}`,
      changeFrequency: "daily",
      priority: 0.7,
    });
  }
  return urls;
}

FILE: narxnoma-web/app/api/revalidate/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * /api/revalidate — called by the crawler after a cycle finishes.
 * POST with `secret` in the body (or ?secret=) matching REVALIDATE_SECRET.
 * Revalidates every cached page so ISR pages reflect the new data.
 */
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const secret = process.env.REVALIDATE_SECRET ?? "dev-secret-change-me";
  let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    body = {};
  }
  const given =
    (body.secret as string | undefined) ??
    req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("secret") ??
    "";
  if (given !== secret) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "invalid secret" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const paths = ["/", "/search", "/stores", "/c/smartphones"];
  for (const p of paths) revalidatePath(p);
  // Revalidate the search results page generically (path-less revalidate of
  // all dynamic segments would be ideal; per-path is deterministic).
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, revalidated: paths });
}

FILE: narxnoma-web/app/api/search/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { parseSearchParams } from "@/lib/searchParams";
import { searchVariants } from "@/lib/queries";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

/**
 * /api/search — JSON twin of the SSR search page. Facet toggles fetch this
 * instead of navigating, so filtering is instant while the URL stays
 * shareable. Same parse + same query as the page: no drift possible.
 */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const sp = Object.fromEntries(req.nextUrl.searchParams.entries());
  const p = parseSearchParams(sp);
  try {
    const res = await searchVariants({
      qNorm: p.qNorm,
      qTokens: p.qTokens,
      brands: p.brands,
      colors: p.colors,
      rams: p.rams,
      priceLo: p.priceLo,
      priceHi: p.priceHi,
      multiStore: p.multiStore,
      category: p.category,
      priced: p.priced,
      sort: p.sort,
      page: p.page,
    });
    return NextResponse.json(res);
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "search failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: narxnoma-web/app/api/suggest/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getSearchSuggestions } from "@/lib/queries";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const q = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("q")?.trim() ?? "";
  if (!q || q.length < 2) {
    return NextResponse.json({ variants: [], brands: [] });
  }
  try {
    const r = await getSearchSuggestions(q);
    return NextResponse.json(r);
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ variants: [], brands: [] });
  }
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import InfiniteGrid from "@/components/InfiniteGrid";
import Pager from "@/components/Pager";
import { langFromCookie, plural, t } from "@/lib/i18n";
import { getBrandsByCategory, searchVariants } from "@/lib/queries";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ category: string }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { category } = await params;
  // The slug is not a title: a non-phone category rendered as "televisions"
  // in the browser tab and in every search-engine result.
  const RU: Record<string, string> = {
    smartphones: "Смартфоны",
    televisions: "Телевизоры",
    laptops: "Ноутбуки",
    acs: "Кондиционеры",
    fridges: "Холодильники",
    washers: "Стиральные машины",
    ovens: "Духовые шкафы и плиты",
  };
  return { title: `${RU[category] ?? category} — Narxnoma` };
}

export default async function CategoryPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ category: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const { category } = await params;
  const page = Math.max(1, Number((await searchParams).page) || 1);
  const lang = langFromCookie((await cookies()).get("lang")?.value);

  // Was getCategoryProducts(category, 24) with no paging at all -- the page
  // showed the first 24 and offered nothing but a link out to /catalog.
  // searchVariants is what /api/search runs, so scrolling continues the very
  // list the server rendered rather than a subtly different one, and
  // `priced: true` keeps the min_price filter the old query had. Its ordering
  // is the same store_count-first ranking; the only difference is that it no
  // longer breaks ties on in_stock_offer_count before price. That function is
  // now gone rather than left beside this one to drift.
  const [res, brandRows] = await Promise.all([
    searchVariants({
      qNorm: "",
      qTokens: [],
      brands: [],
      colors: [],
      rams: [],
      priceLo: null,
      priceHi: null,
      multiStore: false,
      category,
      priced: true,
      sort: "stores",
      page,
    }),
    getBrandsByCategory(),
  ]);
  const total = res.total;
  const rows = brandRows.filter((r) => r.category === category);
  const gridQs = `category=${encodeURIComponent(category)}&sort=stores&priced=1`;
  const catLabel = (c: string) => {
    const v = t(lang, `cat.${c}`);
    return v && !v.startsWith("cat.") ? v : c;
  };

  return (
    <main>
      <div className="page">
        <section className="sec">
          <div className="breadcrumbs" style={{ paddingTop: 0 }}>
            <a href="/">{lang === "uz" ? "Bosh sahifa" : "Главная"}</a>
            {" · "}
            <span>{catLabel(category)}</span>
          </div>
          <h1>{catLabel(category)}</h1>
          <p className="sub">
            {lang === "uz"
              ? `Narxlar O'zbekistondagi 7 do'konda solishtiriladi, har biri avtomatik tekshiriladi.`
              : "цены из 7 магазинов Узбекистана, каждая проверяется автоматически."}
          </p>

          {res.hits.length > 0 && (
            <>
              <div className="row-head" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                <h2 style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                  {plural(lang, total, "mahsulot", "товар", "товара", "товаров")}
                </h2>
                <Link href={`/catalog?category=${category}`} className="more-link">
                  {lang === "uz" ? "Barchasini ko'rish →" : "Смотреть все →"}
                </Link>
              </div>
              <InfiniteGrid
                initialHits={res.hits}
                initialPage={res.page}
                pages={res.pages}
                total={total}
                qs={gridQs}
                pagerFallback={
                  <Pager page={res.page} pages={res.pages} basePath={`/c/${category}`} />
                }
              />
            </>
          )}

          <div className="result-head" style={{ marginTop: 28 }}>
            <h2>{lang === "uz" ? "Brend bo'yicha" : "По брендам"}</h2>
          </div>
          {rows.length ? (
            <div className="brand-grid">
              {rows.map((b) => (
                <Link
                  key={b.brand}
                  className="brand-tile"
                  href={`/c/${b.category}/${b.brand}`}
                >
                  <span className="b-name">{b.brand}</span>
                  <span className="b-meta">
                    {plural(lang, b.count, "model", "модель", "модели", "моделей")}
                  </span>
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p className="sub">{lang === "uz" ? "Hozircha bo'sh." : "Пока пусто."}</p>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";

import { langFromCookie, plural, price, t } from "@/lib/i18n";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function generateMetadata({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ category: string; brand: string }>;
}): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { brand } = await params;
  return { title: brand.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + brand.slice(1) };
}

export default async function BrandPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ category: string; brand: string }>;
}) {
  const { category, brand } = await params;
  const lang = langFromCookie((await cookies()).get("lang")?.value);
  const res = await searchVariants({
    // qNorm ranks; qTokens filters. The brand is already an exact filter
    // below, so adding it as a name token would additionally require the
    // brand to appear in the display name and quietly drop rows it does not.
    qNorm: brand,
    qTokens: [],
    brands: [brand],
    colors: [],
    rams: [],
    priceLo: null,
    priceHi: null,
    multiStore: false,
    category,
    sort: "relevance",
    page: 1,
  });
  const counts = (await getBrandsByCategory()).filter(
    (r) => r.category === category && r.brand === brand
  );
  const c = counts[0];
  return (
    <main>
      <div className="page">
        <section className="sec">
          <div className="breadcrumbs" style={{ paddingTop: 0 }}>
            <a href="/">{lang === "uz" ? "Bosh sahifa" : "Главная"}</a>
            {" · "}
            <a href={`/c/${category}`}>
              {(() => {
                const v = t(lang, `cat.${category}`);
                return v && !v.startsWith("cat.") ? v : category;
              })()}
            </a>
          </div>
          <h1 style={{ textTransform: "capitalize" }}>{brand}</h1>
          <p className="sub">
            {c
              ? `${plural(lang, c.count, "model", "модель в каталоге", "модели в каталоге", "моделей в каталоге")} · ${lang === "uz" ? "dan" : "от"} ${price(lang, c.min_price)}`
              : lang === "uz"
                ? "Katalogdagi modellar."
                : "Модели из каталога."}
          </p>
          <div className="grid">
            {res.hits.map((v) => (
              <VariantCard key={v.id} v={v} />
            ))}
          </div>
          {res.hits.length > 24 && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
              <Link href={`/search?brand=${brand}`} style={{ textDecoration: "underline" }}>
                {lang === "uz"
                  ? `Barcha ${brand} modellarini ko'rsatish →`
                  : `Показать все модели ${brand} →`}
              </Link>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

import Link from "next/link";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import InfiniteGrid from "@/components/InfiniteGrid";
import Pager from "@/components/Pager";
import { langFromCookie, plural, t } from "@/lib/i18n";

export default async function CatalogPage({
  searchParams,

  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const lang = langFromCookie((await cookies()).get("lang")?.value);
  const p = parseSearchParams(sp);
  const category = p.category ?? null;

  const [brandRows, res] = await Promise.all([
    getBrandsByCategory(),
    searchVariants({ ...p, sort: "price_asc", page: Math.max(1, p.page) }),
  ]);

  // What InfiniteGrid appends must be the SAME query the server just ran, so
  // the filters and the sort are carried and `page` is left for the grid.
  const grid = new URLSearchParams();
  if (category) grid.set("category", category);
  grid.set("sort", "price_asc");
  const gridQs = grid.toString();

  // Category counts for the filter bar.
  const catCount = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const b of brandRows) catCount.set(b.category, (catCount.get(b.category) ?? 0) + Number(b.count));
  const categories = ["smartphones", "televisions", "laptops", "acs", "fridges", "washers", "ovens"];

  const label = (c: string) => {
    const v = t(lang, `cat.${c}`);
    return v && !v.startsWith("cat.") ? v : c;
  };

  return (
    <main>
      <div className="page">
        <section className="sec">
          <h1>{category ? label(category) : t(lang, "catalog.title")}</h1>

          {/* Category filter bar: switch category at any moment. */}
          <div className="cat-filter" role="group" aria-label="categories">
            {categories.map((c) => {
              const active = c === category;
              return (
                <Link
                  key={c}
                  href={active ? "/catalog" : `/catalog?category=${c}`}
                  className={`cat-chip${active ? " active" : ""}`}
                  aria-current={active ? "page" : undefined}
                >
                  {label(c)}
                  <span className="chip-n">{catCount.get(c) ?? 0}</span>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <p className="sub">
            {res.total > 0
              ? `${plural(lang, res.total, "model", "модель", "модели", "моделей")} ${
                  lang === "uz" ? "katalogda" : "в каталоге"
                }`
              : lang === "uz" ? "Hozircha bo'sh." : "Пока пусто."}
          </p>

          {/* Scrolling appends the next page; the numbered links below stay
              as the manual route, and are what a crawler (and a browser with
              a broken fetch) follows. */}
          <InfiniteGrid
            initialHits={res.hits}
            initialPage={res.page}
            pages={res.pages}
            total={res.total}
            qs={gridQs}
            pagerFallback={
              <Pager
                page={res.page}
                pages={res.pages}
                basePath="/catalog"
                query={{ category: category ?? undefined }}
              />
            }
          />
        </section>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

  gray: "#8b877f",

export async function generateMetadata({

export default async function ProductPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const lang = langFromCookie((await cookies()).get("lang")?.value);
  const page = await getVariantPage(slug);
  if (!page.variant) notFound();

  const v = page.variant;
  const pr = page.price;

  const newest = page.offers.reduce<string | null>(
    (m, o) => (m == null || o.last_seen > m ? o.last_seen : m),
    null
  );
  const stale = newest != null && Date.now() - new Date(newest).getTime() > 24 * 3600_000;

  const cheapestInStock = page.offers.find((o) => o.availability === "IN_STOCK");
  const cheapestUnknown = page.offers.find((o) => o.availability === "UNKNOWN");

  const avail = (a: string) => {
    if (a === "IN_STOCK") return { label: t(lang, "p.inStock"), cls: "in-stock" };
    if (a === "OUT_OF_STOCK") return { label: t(lang, "p.outStock"), cls: "out-of-stock" };
    return { label: t(lang, "p.unknown"), cls: "unknown" };
  };
  const catLabel = (c: string) =>
    c === "smartphones" ? t(lang, "cat.smartphones") : c;

  return (
    <main>
      <div className="page">
        <div className="breadcrumbs">
          <a href="/">{lang === "uz" ? "Bosh sahifa" : "Главная"}</a>
          {" · "}
          <a href={`/c/${v.category}`}>{catLabel(v.category)}</a>
          {" · "}
          <a href={`/c/${v.category}/${v.brand}`}>{v.brand}</a>
          {/* Colour is identity only for phones. Outside them it is NULL, and
              the old "—" placeholder left a dangling "· —" on every
              television, fridge and laptop breadcrumb. */}
          {v.color && (
            <>
              {" · "}
              <span>{colorRu(v.color)}</span>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {stale &&
          (() => {
            const ago = timeAgo(lang, newest!);
            return <div className="banner">{t(lang, "p.stale", { t: ago })}</div>;
          })()}

        <section className="product">
          {pr?.hero_image_url && (
            <SafeImg
              className="product-hero"
              src={pr.hero_image_url}
              alt={v.display_name}
            />
          )}
          <h1>{v.display_name}</h1>
          {/* Built by joining only the specs this product actually HAS.
              Outside phones, storage/colour/SIM are NULL by design, and the
              old fixed layout rendered a bare " · ГБ" for every television. */}
          <div className="subline">
            {[
              v.ram_gb != null ? `${v.ram_gb} ГБ ОЗУ` : null,
              v.storage_gb != null ? `${v.storage_gb} ГБ` : null,
              v.category === "smartphones"
                ? v.sim_kind === "dual"
                  ? "2 SIM / eSIM"
                  : v.sim_kind === "esim_only"
                    ? "eSIM"
                    : null
                : null,
            ]
              .filter(Boolean)
              .join(" · ")}
          </div>

          <div className="headline">
            <div>
              <div className="from">
                {lang === "uz" ? "dan" : "от"}{" "}
                {pr ? plural(lang, pr.store_count, "do'kon", "магазина", "магазинов", "магазинов") : ""}{" "}
                {pr && pr.store_count > 0
                  ? lang === "uz"
                    ? "· eng arzoni"
                    : "· дешевле всего в"
                  : ""}
              </div>
              <div className="big">{price(lang, pr?.min_price ?? null)}</div>
            </div>
            {pr?.min_offer_name && (
              <div className="provenance">
                {lang === "uz"
                  ? "Narx aniq taklifga tegishli:"
                  : "Цена принадлежит конкретному предложению:"}{" "}
                <span className="q">
                  «{pr.min_offer_name}»{pr.min_store_name ? ` — ${pr.min_store_name}` : ""}
                </span>
                {pr.min_offer_url && (
                  <>
                    {" "}
                    <a href={`/api/out/${pr.min_offer_id ?? ""}`} style={{ textDecoration: "underline" }}>
                      {t(lang, "p.checkInStore")}
                    </a>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {page.siblings.length > 1 && (
            <div className="sibling-picker">
              <h3>{t(lang, "p.otherColors")}</h3>
              <div className="siblings">
                {page.siblings.map((sib) => {
                  const cur = sib.id === v.id;
                  const delta =
                    pr?.min_price != null && sib.min_price != null
                      ? sib.min_price - pr.min_price
                      : null;
                  return (
                    <a
                      key={sib.id}
                      className={`sib${cur ? " cur" : ""}`}
                      href={cur ? undefined : `/p/${sib.slug}`}
                      aria-current={cur ? "page" : undefined}
                    >
                      <span
                        className="swatch"
                        style={{ background: SWATCH_HEX[sib.color] ?? "#ccc" }}
                      />
                      {colorRu(sib.color)}
                      {sib.in_stock_offer_count > 0 ? (
                        <>
                          <span className="sib-price">{price(lang, sib.min_price)}</span>
                          {delta != null && !cur && (
                            <span className={`sib-delta ${delta < 0 ? "delta-down" : "delta-up"}`}>
                              {delta < 0 ? "−" : "+"}
                              {price(lang, Math.abs(delta))}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="sib-soldout">{t(lang, "p.outOfStock")}</span>
                      )}
                    </a>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>

        <section className="compare">
          <div className="compare-head">
            <span>{lang === "uz" ? "Do'kon" : "Магазин"}</span>
            <span>{lang === "uz" ? "Narx dan" : "Цена от"}</span>
            <span>{lang === "uz" ? "Takliflar oralig'i" : "Диапазон предложений"}</span>
            <span>{lang === "uz" ? "Mavjudligi" : "Наличие и проверка"}</span>
          </div>

          {page.stores.length === 0 && (
            <div className="empty" style={{ border: "none" }}>
              {lang === "uz"
                ? "Bu model bo'yicha hozircha taklif yo'q. Keyinroq qarang — katalog avtomatik yangilanadi."
                : "Ни одно предложение по этой модели пока не найдено. Загляните позже — каталог обновляется автоматически."}
            </div>
          )}

          {page.stores.map((s) => {
            const inStockCount = s.in_stock;
            const unkCount = s.offers - s.in_stock;
            const hasStock = inStockCount > 0;
            const storeOffers = page.offers.filter(
              (o) => o.store_slug === s.store_slug
            );
            return (
              <details className="store-row" key={s.store_slug} open={false}>
                <summary>
                  <span className="store-cell-store">
                    <span className="store-badge">{s.store_slug}</span>
                    {s.store_name}
                  </span>
                  <span className="store-cell-price">{price(lang, s.min_p)}</span>
                  <span className="store-cell-range">
                    {s.min_p != null && s.max_p != null && s.max_p > s.min_p
                      ? `${price(lang, s.min_p)} — ${price(lang, s.max_p)}`
                      : s.median_p != null
                        ? `${lang === "uz" ? "mediana" : "медиана"} ${price(lang, s.median_p)}`
                        : "—"}
                  </span>
                  <span className="store-cell-avail">
                    {hasStock ? (
                      <span className="avail in-stock">{t(lang, "p.inStock")}</span>
                    ) : unkCount > 0 ? (
                      <span className="avail unknown">{t(lang, "p.unknown")}</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="avail out-of-stock">{t(lang, "p.outStock")}</span>
                    )}
                    <span className="seen">
                      {plural(lang, s.offers, "taklif", "предложение", "предложения", "предложений")}
                      {" · "}
                      {s.last_seen
                        ? `${lang === "uz" ? "oldin tekshirildi " : "проверено "} ${timeAgo(lang, s.last_seen)}`
                        : ""}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </summary>
                <div className="offers">
                  {storeOffers.map((o) => {
                    const av = avail(o.availability);
                    return (
                      <div className="offer" key={o.id}>
                        <span className="o-name">
                          {o.image_url && (
                            <SafeImg
                              className="o-thumb"
                              src={o.image_url}
                              thumb
                            />
                          )}
                          {o.name_raw}
                          <span className={`avail ${av.cls}`} style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
                            {av.label}
                          </span>
                        </span>
                        <span className="o-price">{price(lang, o.price)}</span>
                        {o.url && (
                          <a className="o-go" href={`/api/out/${o.id}`} rel="nofollow noopener">
                            {lang === "uz" ? "Do'konga →" : "В магазин →"}
                          </a>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </details>
            );
          })}
        </section>

        <p style={{ color: "var(--muted-2)", fontSize: 13, paddingBottom: 40 }}>
          {cheapestInStock ? (
            <>
              {lang === "uz"
                ? `Eng arzoni — ${cheapestInStock.store_name}: «${cheapestInStock.name_raw}» ${price(lang, cheapestInStock.price)}.`
                : `Дешевле всего — ${cheapestInStock.store_name}: «${cheapestInStock.name_raw}» за ${price(lang, cheapestInStock.price)}.`}

          ) : cheapestUnknown ? (

                : `Самая низкая цена — ${cheapestUnknown.store_name}: «${cheapestUnknown.name_raw}» за ${price(lang, cheapestUnknown.price)}. Магазин не указывает наличие.`}
            </>
          ) : (
            (lang === "uz" ? "Sotuvda taklif yo'q." : "Предложений в наличии нет.")
          )}
        </p>

  );

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import SearchClient from "@/components/SearchClient";
import { parseSearchParams } from "@/lib/searchParams";
import { searchVariants } from "@/lib/queries";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Поиск" };

export default async function SearchPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>>;
}) {
  const sp = await searchParams;
  const p = parseSearchParams(sp);
  // Set by the home page when it hands over mid-word; see SearchBox.
  const resumeTyping = sp.typing === "1";
  const res = await searchVariants({
    qNorm: p.qNorm,
    qTokens: p.qTokens,
    brands: p.brands,
    colors: p.colors,
    rams: p.rams,
    priceLo: p.priceLo,
    priceHi: p.priceHi,
    multiStore: p.multiStore,
    category: p.category,
    priced: p.priced,
    sort: p.sort,
    page: p.page,
  });

  return (
    <main>
      <div className="page">
        <SearchClient
          initialResult={res}
          initialQs={p.qs}
          initialRawQ={p.rawQ}
          resumeTyping={resumeTyping}
        />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

FILE: narxnoma-web/components/Facets.tsx

"use client";

import { COLORS, colorRu } from "@/lib/colors";
import { price, t } from "@/lib/i18n";
import { useLang } from "./LangProvider";
import type { SearchResult } from "@/lib/queries";

function toggle(list: string[], v: string): string[] {
  return list.includes(v) ? list.filter((x) => x !== v) : [...list, v];
}

/**
 * Facet sidebar. No navigation of its own: every toggle builds the next URL
 * query string and hands it to onApply (the parent fetches + updates the URL),
 * keeping the checkbox experience instant. `q` is the CURRENT query string.
 */
export default function Facets({
  f,
  applied,
  q,
  onApply,
  className = "",
}: {
  f: SearchResult["facets"];
  applied: SearchResult["applied"];
  q: string;
  onApply: (nextQs: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const sp = new URLSearchParams(q);
  const lang = useLang();

  const patch = (p: Record<string, string | null>) => {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(p)) {
      if (v == null || v === "") sp.delete(k);
      else sp.set(k, v);
    }
    sp.delete("page");
    onApply(sp.toString());
  };

  const activeBrands = sp.getAll("brand").flatMap((x) => x.split(",")).filter(Boolean);
  const activeColors = sp.getAll("color").flatMap((x) => x.split(",")).filter(Boolean);
  const activeRams = sp.getAll("ram").flatMap((x) => x.split(",")).filter(Boolean);
  const activePrice = sp.get("price");

  const setBrand = (b: string) =>
    patch({ brand: toggle(activeBrands, b).join(",") });
  const setColor = (c: string) =>
    patch({ color: toggle(activeColors, c).join(",") });
  const setRam = (r: string) => {
    const key = r === "none" ? "none" : r;
    patch({ ram: toggle(activeRams, key).join(",") });
  };
  const setBand = (lo: number) =>
    patch({ price: activePrice === String(lo) ? null : String(lo) });
  const setMulti = () => patch({ multi: applied.multiStore ? null : "1" });

  return (
    <aside className={`facets ${className}`.trim()}>
      <div className="facet-group">
        <h3>{t(lang, "facet.onlyComparable")}</h3>
        <label className="facet-row">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={applied.multiStore} onChange={setMulti} />
          <span className="f-label">{t(lang, "facet.multi")}</span>
        </label>
      </div>

      <div className="facet-group">
        <h3>{t(lang, "facet.brand")}</h3>
        {f.brands.map((b) => (
          <label className="facet-row" key={b.value}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={activeBrands.includes(String(b.value))}
              onChange={() => setBrand(String(b.value))}
            />
            <span className="f-label">{String(b.value)}</span>
            <span className="f-count">{b.count}</span>
          </label>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="facet-group">
        <h3>{t(lang, "facet.color")}</h3>
        {f.colors.map((c) => {
          const key = String(c.value);
          return (
            <label className="facet-row" key={key}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={activeColors.includes(key)}
                onChange={() => setColor(key)}
              />
              <span className={`facet-swatch sw-${key}`} />
              <span className="f-label">{colorRu(key)}</span>
              <span className="f-count">{c.count}</span>
            </label>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="facet-group">
        <h3>{t(lang, "facet.ram")}</h3>
        {f.rams.map((r) => {
          const key = r == null ? "none" : String(r);
          return (
            <label className="facet-row" key={key}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={activeRams.includes(key)}
                onChange={() => setRam(key)}
              />
              <span className="f-label">
                {r == null ? t(lang, "facet.none") : `${r} ГБ`}
              </span>
              <span className="f-count">{f.ramCounts[key] ?? 0}</span>
            </label>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {f.priceBands.length > 0 && (
        <div className="facet-group">
          <h3>{t(lang, "facet.price")}</h3>
          {f.priceBands.map((b) => (
            <label className="facet-row" key={b.lo}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={activePrice === String(b.lo)}
                onChange={() => setBand(b.lo)}
              />
              <span className="f-label">
                {price(lang, b.lo)} — {price(lang, b.hi)}
              </span>
              <span className="f-count">{b.count}</span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {COLORS.length > 0 && (
        <div className="facet-group" style={{ display: "none" }}>
          <h3>Цвет</h3>
        </div>
      )}
    </aside>
  );
}

FILE: narxnoma-web/components/InfiniteGrid.tsx

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import VariantCard from "./VariantCard";
import { useLang } from "./LangProvider";
import type { SearchResult, VariantHit } from "@/lib/queries";

/**
 * Backstop only. Appending normally pushes the sentinel out of view, and the
 * observer below acts on its RETURN, so one gesture buys one page. This bounds
 * the pathological case where the appended rows are shorter than the
 * observer's margin and the sentinel therefore never leaves: after this many
 * consecutive loads the reader has to press the button. Restored the moment
 * the sentinel does go out of view.
 */
const AUTO_BUDGET = 4;

/**
 * A results grid that grows as you scroll, over /api/search.
 *
 * THE PAGER STAYS. Infinite scroll has exactly one failure mode that matters:
 * when the fetch breaks, the page simply stops producing goods and looks
 * finished rather than broken. So this renders `pagerFallback` -- the ordinary
 * numbered links the page rendered server-side -- underneath, and a "show
 * more" button that works whether or not the observer ever fires. Nothing here
 * depends on IntersectionObserver being supported, or on scrolling happening
 * at all.
 *
 * The first page is NOT fetched: it is server-rendered and handed in as
 * `initialHits`, so the page is complete and indexable before any JavaScript
 * runs, and the scroll only ever appends page 2 onward.
 */
export default function InfiniteGrid({
  initialHits,
  initialPage,
  pages,
  total,
  qs,
  pagerFallback,
  onLoaded,
}: {
  initialHits: VariantHit[];
  initialPage: number;
  pages: number;
  total: number;
  /** Query string for /api/search WITHOUT `page`. */
  qs: string;
  /** The server-rendered numbered pager, kept as the manual fallback. */
  pagerFallback?: React.ReactNode;
  /** Told the running total, for a heading that counts what is on screen. */
  onLoaded?: (shown: number) => void;
}) {
  const lang = useLang();
  const [hits, setHits] = useState<VariantHit[]>(initialHits);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(initialPage);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);
  const sentinel = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  /** Which result set the in-flight request belongs to. */
  const wantQs = useRef(qs);
  wantQs.current = qs;
  /** Backstop for a sentinel that never leaves view; see AUTO_BUDGET. */
  const autoLeft = useRef(AUTO_BUDGET);
  /** Previous intersection state, so we can act on the rising edge only. */
  const wasVisible = useRef(false);

  // A filter, sort or query change hands down a new first page. Replace
  // rather than append -- appending across two different result sets is how
  // an infinite list starts showing a mixture nobody asked for.
  //
  // Keyed on the IDENTITY of initialHits, not on `qs`. Keying it on qs was
  // wrong in a way worth recording: the parent sets the new query string
  // immediately and the new rows only arrive when the fetch resolves, so the
  // reset fired on the render that still carried the OLD rows, and the render
  // that finally carried the new ones was skipped as "same qs". Changing the
  // sort updated the URL and the active chip while the products underneath
  // stayed exactly as they were.
  useEffect(() => {
    setHits(initialHits);
    setPage(initialPage);
    setFailed(false);
    autoLeft.current = AUTO_BUDGET;
  }, [initialHits, initialPage]);

  useEffect(() => {
    onLoaded?.(hits.length);
  }, [hits.length, onLoaded]);

  const more = useCallback(
    async (auto: boolean) => {
      if (loading || page >= pages) return;
      if (auto && autoLeft.current <= 0) return;
      if (auto) autoLeft.current -= 1;
      else autoLeft.current = AUTO_BUDGET; // a click re-arms the automatic run
      setLoading(true);
      setFailed(false);
      const want = page + 1;
      const forQs = qs;
      try {
        const r = await fetch(`/api/search?${qs}&page=${want}`);
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
        const j = (await r.json()) as SearchResult;
        if (wantQs.current !== forQs) return; // filters moved on; drop it
        setHits((prev) => {
          // The catalogue moves under us between requests, so page N+1 can
          // repeat a row from page N. De-duplicate by id rather than trusting
          // OFFSET to be stable.
          const seen = new Set(prev.map((h) => h.id));
          return [...prev, ...j.hits.filter((h) => !seen.has(h.id))];
        });
        setPage(want);
      } catch {
        setFailed(true);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    },
    [loading, page, pages, qs]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = sentinel.current;
    if (!node || page >= pages || failed) return;
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") return; // button still works
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        const now = entries[entries.length - 1].isIntersecting;
        const was = wasVisible.current;
        wasVisible.current = now;
        // ONE load per arrival, on the rising edge only.
        //
        // Firing on `isIntersecting` alone reads as "the end is near", which
        // stays true after the append: the observer refires as fast as the
        // API answers and one flick to the bottom becomes a burst. Measured
        // on /c/televisions, that pulled 840 products and 35 requests in a
        // few seconds. It also cannot be fixed by re-arming on scroll --
        // scrolling fires continuously and just refills whatever budget it
        // is guarding.
        //
        // The honest signal is the sentinel ARRIVING. It can only arrive
        // again after the rows just appended have pushed it back out of
        // view, which is exactly "the reader got to the bottom again".
        if (now && !was) more(true);
        if (!now) autoLeft.current = AUTO_BUDGET; // left view: budget restored
      },
      // Fetch a little before the sentinel is on screen, so the next rows are
      // usually there by the time the reader arrives.
      { rootMargin: "300px 0px" }
    );
    io.observe(node);
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, [more, page, pages, failed]);

  const done = page >= pages;
  const label = failed
    ? lang === "uz" ? "Qayta urinish" : "Повторить"
    : loading
      ? lang === "uz" ? "Yuklanmoqda…" : "Загружаем…"
      : lang === "uz" ? "Yana ko'rsatish" : "Показать ещё";

  return (
    <>
      <div className="grid">
        {hits.map((v) => (
          <VariantCard key={v.id} v={v} />
        ))}
      </div>

      {!done && <div ref={sentinel} aria-hidden="true" style={{ height: 1 }} />}

      {!done && (
        <div className="more-row">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="more-btn"
            onClick={() => more(false)}
            disabled={loading}
          >
            {label}
          </button>
          <span className="count">
            {hits.length} / {total}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {failed && (
        <div className="banner">
          {lang === "uz"
            ? "Keyingi sahifani yuklab bo'lmadi — quyidagi sahifa raqamlaridan foydalaning."
            : "Не удалось подгрузить следующую страницу — воспользуйтесь номерами страниц ниже."}
        </div>
      )}

      {pagerFallback}
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { createContext, useContext } from "react";
import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";

const LangContext = createContext<Lang>("ru");

export function LangProvider({ lang, children }: { lang: Lang; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <LangContext.Provider value={lang}>{children}</LangContext.Provider>;
}

export function useLang(): Lang {
  return useContext(LangContext);
}

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useLang } from "./LangProvider";
import type { Lang } from "@/lib/i18n";

/** RU/UZ toggle. Sets the lang cookie and refreshes to re-render localized. */
export default function LangSwitcher() {
  const lang = useLang();
  const router = useRouter();
  const set = (next: Lang) => {
    document.cookie = `lang=${next}; path=/; max-age=31536000`;
    router.refresh();
  };
  return (
    <span className="lang-switch" role="group" aria-label="Язык / Til">
      {(["ru", "uz"] as Lang[]).map((l) => (
        <button
          key={l}
          className={l === lang ? "on" : ""}
          onClick={() => l !== lang && set(l)}
          type="button"
          aria-pressed={l === lang}
        >
          {l === "ru" ? "RU" : "UZ"}
        </button>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

FILE: narxnoma-web/components/Pager.tsx
================================================
import Link from "next/link";

/**
 * Numbered page links — the manual route that stays available underneath the
 * scroll-appended grid.
 *
 * A component rather than inline JSX in each page, for two reasons. It was
 * duplicated verbatim in /catalog and /c/[category]; and passing this markup
 * inline as a prop from a server component into the client `InfiniteGrid`
 * made React warn about missing keys on every load. The children of the
 * `<nav>` are a static list (`{prev}{numbers}{next}`), which React normally
 * exempts from the key rule via a flag set at JSX-creation time — a flag that
 * does not survive being serialised across the server/client boundary and
 * rebuilt. Handing over one already-rendered element instead of a children
 * array sidesteps the question rather than papering over it with keys that
 * the markup does not otherwise need.
 */
export default function Pager({
  page,
  pages,
  basePath,
  query = {},
}: {
  page: number;
  pages: number;
  /** e.g. "/catalog" or "/c/televisions" */
  basePath: string;
  /** Filters to carry on every page link. `page` is added here. */
  query?: Record<string, string | undefined>;
}) {
  if (pages <= 1) return null;

  const href = (n: number) => {
    const sp = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(query)) if (v) sp.set(k, v);
    sp.set("page", String(n));
    return `${basePath}?${sp.toString()}`;
  };

  // First, last, and a window of two either side of the current page.
  const shown = Array.from({ length: pages }, (_, i) => i + 1).filter(
    (n) => n === 1 || n === pages || Math.abs(n - page) <= 2
  );

  return (
    <nav className="pagination" aria-label="pagination">
      {page > 1 && (
        <Link href={href(page - 1)} rel="prev">
          ←
        </Link>
      )}
      {shown.map((n, idx) => (
        <span key={n} style={{ display: "inline-flex", gap: 4 }}>
          {idx > 0 && shown[idx - 1] !== n - 1 ? (
            <span className="pg-ellipsis">…</span>
          ) : null}
          <Link
            href={href(n)}
            className={n === page ? "cur" : ""}
            aria-current={n === page ? "page" : undefined}
          >
            {n}
          </Link>
        </span>
      ))}
      {page < pages && (
        <Link href={href(page + 1)} rel="next">
          →
        </Link>
      )}
    </nav>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

/**
 * Hotlinked image with graceful failure. Server components cannot pass
 * event handlers, so broken-image handling lives here: an <img> that fails
 * to load collapses to a letter placeholder (or nothing for a thumbnail).
 */
export default function SafeImg({
  src,
  alt = "",
  thumb = false,
  className = "",
}: {
  src: string;
  alt?: string;
  thumb?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const [err, setErr] = useState(false);
  if (thumb) {
    return err ? null : (
      <img
        className={className}
        src={src}
        alt=""
        loading="lazy"
        decoding="async"
        referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
        onError={() => setErr(true)}
      />
    );
  }
  if (err) {
    return (
      <div className={`${className} img-missing`} aria-hidden="true">
        <span>{alt ? alt.charAt(0).toUpperCase() : "?"}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
      <img
        src={src}
        alt={alt}
        loading="lazy"
        decoding="async"
        referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
        onError={() => setErr(true)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
